reviewed_stories.title: CPHL FY26 profit softens 11%

reviewed_stories.title: Oil supply relief tempers the prior Middle East price shock
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector linkage to configured Oil & Gas Exploration names OGDC, PPL and MARI; this is not a company-specific operational disclosure.
reviewed_stories.reason: Brent eased to about $101 as G7 countries planned a 100m-barrel strategic-stock release and Middle East exports recovered above pre-war levels on several recent days. OPEC+ kept November targets steady and diplomatic talks are active, but attacks and Gulf infrastructure risk remain. This materially softens the prior positive supply-shock thread without establishing a clean negative oil-price regime.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Primary Mettis article verified at 10:01 AM PKT. Supporting OPEC+ article was published at 05:09 AM PKT and the UN mediation article at 10:33 AM PKT.
